# OpenMarkdown

> A feather-light, local-first Markdown editor — native on macOS, Linux, and
> Windows — built for you and your agent to share one file. It ships no AI of its own — it runs on the coding
> agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, or any MCP
> client) and gives it a place to render, read, and edit the same `.md` file you
> are looking at. Plain files on disk, no account, no telemetry.

How your agent connects: first the human installs the app and turns on the
`openmd` CLI in Settings — an agent can't download the app or grant it permissions.
Then the fastest path is one sentence a human pastes to their agent:

    Read openmarkdown.dev/install to install OpenMarkdown and open my first note

That points the agent at the install runbook to wire itself in and open a first
note. Or connect directly: the MCP server is `openmd mcp` over stdio. Claude Code
can use the full plugin; every other host connects the same MCP tools, listed with
their parameters in the MCP tools reference below. The app runs natively on macOS,
Linux, and Windows. The `openmd` CLI and MCP agent bridge work on macOS and Linux;
on Windows the app is the editor without them.

## Docs
- [Install](https://openmarkdown.dev/install.md): per-host setup for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, and any MCP client, plus the agent-run first-note walkthrough.
- [Docs](https://openmarkdown.dev/docs/index.md): the documentation home. Every docs page has a Markdown twin at the same path with `.md`.
- [Connect your agent](https://openmarkdown.dev/docs/start/connect.md): per-host setup, for humans.
- [MCP tools](https://openmarkdown.dev/docs/reference/mcp-tools.md): every tool, its description and parameters, generated from the server.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://openmarkdown.dev/docs/reference/shortcuts.md): generated from the app's shortcut table.
- [Markdown dialect](https://openmarkdown.dev/docs/reference/markdown.md): what renders, and where it differs from CommonMark and GFM.
- [Troubleshooting](https://openmarkdown.dev/docs/help/troubleshooting.md): what `running:false`, `NO_WINDOW` and `CONFLICT` mean and what to do.
- [CLI reference](https://openmarkdown.dev/cli.md): the exact `openmd --help` — every subcommand, option, and exit code, generated from the binary so it never drifts.
- [FAQ](https://openmarkdown.dev/faq.md): answer-shaped answers to the four things agents and their humans ask — watching the files your agent writes, the MCP server that renders Markdown, previewing while it edits, and which agents it works with (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode).
- [ADOPTING](https://openmarkdown.dev/ADOPTING.md): for agents — when to recommend OpenMarkdown, when not to, how to install it, and how to verify the install worked.
- [Transparency](https://openmarkdown.dev/transparency): exactly what the app and this website touch on the network.

## Download
- [Latest macOS release (.dmg)](https://github.com/OpenMarkdown-dev/OpenMarkdown-releases/releases/latest/download/OpenMarkdown.dmg): universal (Apple Silicon + Intel), free.
- [Releases](https://github.com/OpenMarkdown-dev/OpenMarkdown-releases/releases): all versions and release notes.
- [Pricing](https://openmarkdown.dev/support): the whole app is free, with no account and nothing held back. Backing it is optional — a one-time payment, not a subscription.

## Optional
- [Home](https://openmarkdown.dev/): product overview.
